_about: Portfolio cut (premium, ~90-95 s) of the WhatsApp Commerce V2 video, built by bin/demo (see README.md). Spoken text is spelled out for speech; every claim traces to docs/evidence/PORTFOLIO_CLAIMS.md and the verification write-ups. Segment 02-whatsapp is REAL: the author's own phone screen recordings of 7 Oct 2026 (catalog, product, cart; then Place order, the app's receipt and, after the operator accepted it in the admin, the confirmation of real order #11), rendered by motion.mjs from whatsapp-motion.json; the narration describes only what those frames show. Segment 03-demo is SYNTHETIC (a local database, same code, Meta replaced by an in-process fake): it opens with an 'Application demo · synthetic data' card and every local frame carries a small DEMO DATA tag. b13-b14 are real verification evidence (6 Oct 2026). min_seconds keeps a beat's picture at least that long. crf is the final encode quality (lower is better). Voice: Kokoro-82M af_heart at speed 0.95.

beats.text: Version one dropped every delivery status and hid its errors.

beats.visual: real phone recording: the chat, the catalog opening and scrolling
beats.text: First, the real thing, recorded on the author's phone. The catalog opens right inside WhatsApp.

beats.visual: real phone recording: Classic Lasagne, Add to order request, back to the catalog, + Apple Berry Smoothie
beats.text: Open the lasagne, add it to the cart, then go back for a smoothie.

beats.visual: real phone recording: the cart, 2 items at catalog prices, estimated total
beats.text: The cart shows both, at their catalog prices.

beats.visual: real phone recording: Place order, the chat with the sent cart, the app's receipt for order #11 arriving
beats.text: Then place the order, and the app's receipt comes straight back: order number eleven.

beats.visual: real phone recording: the confirmation for order #11 arriving after the operator accepted it
beats.text: Once the operator accepts it, the confirmation arrives too.

beats.visual: how it works: WhatsApp, webhook, persist, queue, process, order validation, reply and status tracking
beats.text: Behind it, every webhook is verified, stored and acknowledged, then processed once in the background, and every reply is tracked.

beats.visual: application demo card (synthetic data), then the operator's conversation view for the synthetic hero customer
beats.text: Now the operator's view, with demo data: Maya says hi and sends her cart.

beats.visual: order detail: lines, customer price vs catalog price, total
beats.text: Each line is checked against the catalog price.

beats.visual: order accepted + notification sent, delivered, read timestamps
beats.text: Once accepted, the reply is tracked through each status update: sent, delivered, read.

beats.visual: health page: failures by category, unknown outcome never resent
beats.text: Failures stay visible, and an ambiguous send is never resent.
On October sixth it ran against real Meta traffic, and every delivery was applied once.

beats.visual: 131009 card: Meta's stored details, cause in the commerce settings, fixed in Meta
beats.text: The first catalog card failed with error one three one, zero zero nine. Its stored details pointed to a commerce setting, fixed by hand in Meta.
Eleven hundred and twelve tests pass, CI runs security scans, and it's deployed over HTTPS.
WhatsApp Commerce, version two. More at amit solanki dot com.
